# Until this file existed, the only robots.txt served was Cloudflare's Content
# Signals preamble: twenty-odd lines of comments announcing that access is
# conditional on signals, followed by no signals and no directives at all.
#
# The call made here:
#   search=yes    being findable is the entire job of this site.
#   ai-input=yes  someone asking an assistant how to text family on a cruise
#                 is a real way to discover CruiseMesh, and that answer is
#                 better if it can read the actual pages.
#   ai-train=no   no reason to hand over the corpus; nothing is gained back.
User-Agent: *
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no
Allow: /

# Per-family card pages. Both are already noindex, both are meaningless
# without the fragment a crawler never receives, and nothing good comes of one
# being held in an index. /relay/ is the post-purchase success page.
Disallow: /f/
Disallow: /r/
Disallow: /relay/

Sitemap: https://cruisemesh.app/sitemap.xml
